cost: Source/input hashing plus O(d^3) validation, O(d^2) RLS algebra, selected subprocess work and artifact I/O; d<=32.
description: Prospective runtime predictions, observed benchmark evidence and cohort-bound recursive least-squares corrections.
forward: CLI preparation binds cohort and evidence, predicts with M, and records a forecast before a requested execution.
Accepted observations update the library model before an evidence-bound checkpoint is written.
inverse: A failed observed run cannot enter the normal accepted-observation checkpoint path.
Forecasts and fitted parameters cannot uniquely reconstruct benchmark histories or prove future runtime.
limitations: Current finite-precision gates and caller invariants are modeled separately from exact RLS identities.
No new external benchmark command, end-to-end process trace or calibrated uncertainty guarantee is supplied.
